name: Perov-5
description: 18,928 cubic ABX3 perovskites with relaxed structures, formation enthalpy (heat_all, eV/atom) and direct band gap (dir_gap, eV). The CDVAE split of the Castelli et al. (2012) perovskite set; the dataset behind the published MEIDNet model and the live Studio.
citation: Castelli et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 5, 5814 (2012); Xie et al., ICLR 2022 (CDVAE)
role: the published multimodal benchmark: alignment, property reconstruction and inverse design
